title: Show the AI examples
summary: Paste one or two samples and ask the AI to write in the same style

steps.body:
Sometimes the style you want is hard to describe, like "cute, the way our shop does it".

The easier way: **show the AI an example** and say "write like this".

How to do it:
1. Say what you want the AI to do
2. Paste 1–2 examples and mark clearly which part is the example
3. Say how many you want and what they're about

One example shows many things at once: **length, emojis, line breaks and tone**.

steps.bad: Write 3 cute captions for my chili paste
steps.prompt:
I sell homemade Thai chili paste on my Facebook page. Write captions for 3 new products in the same style as these 2 examples.

Example 1:
Grandma's Fiery Chili Paste 🌶️
Seriously hot, perfect with an omelet
59 baht a jar, message us to order

Example 2:
Freshly Roasted Red-Eye Chili Paste 🔥
Rich garlic aroma, amazing with fresh veggies
59 baht a jar, message us to order

New products: mackerel chili paste, Chiang Mai green chili paste, southern shrimp chili paste, 69 baht a jar
steps.output:
Homestyle Mackerel Chili Paste 🐟
Packed with fish, best with boiled veggies
69 baht a jar, message us to order

Authentic Chiang Mai Green Chili Paste 🌿
Smoky grilled chilies, perfect with pork crackling
69 baht a jar, message us to order

Southern Shrimp Chili Paste 🦐
Fragrant shrimp, just the right heat, great with hot rice
69 baht a jar, message us to order
steps.note: The AI copied every pattern: 3 lines, an emoji after the name, what to eat it with, and the price at the end.

steps.question: You've already given examples. Why do you still need to give the new product details (names, price)?
options: You don't — the AI can guess
The AI copies the style but doesn't know the new facts; without them it may make things up
steps.explain: Examples teach "how to write". Real facts — product names, prices, dates — you have to provide yourself.

steps.task: You own a coffee shop and want to send a LINE message announcing 2 new drinks. Write a prompt asking the AI for 3 versions to choose from, and include 1–2 messages your shop sent before as examples (you can make them up).
rubric: Includes at least 1 actual example message, clearly marked as the example
Asks the AI to follow the example's style and says how many versions (3)
Gives the new facts needed (drink names, prices or promotion)
Gives context (what shop, who it's for, sent on LINE)
